title: HMRC email updates, videos and webinars for company directors
text:
Subscribe to receive email updates

 Subscribe to the HMRC help and support email service to get information on a wide range of topics for individuals, businesses, employers and agents.

 You can also:

 • make changes to your topic subscriptions

 • unsubscribe from the service whenever you want

 Registering and joining webinars

 You can register for webinars in advance but we recommend you join each webinar 5 minutes before the start.

 Self Assessment

 New to Self Assessment

 Watch a collection of videos about being new to Self Assessment.

 New to Self Assessment 

 You’ll find out about:

 • key dates

 • the tax return

 • understanding your calculation

 • budgeting for and paying your tax bill

 • record keeping

 • the HMRC app

 • personal and business tax accounts

 Online Self Assessment tax return

 Watch a collection of videos about your online Self Assessment tax return.

 Your online Self Assessment tax return 

 You’ll find out about:

 • starting your tax return

 • the different sections of the return including the:

 • self-employment section

 • UK property section

 • other income and tax reliefs

 • finishing your return

 • your calculation and payments

 Corporation Tax

 Watch a collection of videos about Corporation Tax.

 Corporation Tax 

 You’ll find out:

 • what Corporation Tax is

 • how to complete your first Corporation Tax accounts

 • how to pay your Corporation Tax bill

 Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism

 Watch a video the about Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism.

 What is the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism? 

 You will find out about:

 • why the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism is being introduced

 • how the Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism works

 • which sectors are affected

 • how businesses and tax agents need to prepare

 Company directors — payroll and you

 Live webinar

 Register for the next live webinar about company directors — payroll and you .

 This webinar is for new company directors and more experienced directors who want to refresh their knowledge.

 You’ll learn about:

 • directors’ responsibilities

 • directors and PAYE

 • expenses and benefits

 • keeping records

 • Income Tax and National Insurance contributions that directors pay

 • payroll information that has to be submitted to HMRC

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about company directors — payroll and you .

 UK Freeports

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a  recorded webinar about UK Freeports .

 You’ll learn about:

 • UK Freeports

 • possible tax and customs benefits of locating in a Freeport customs site

 Work related expenses

 Watch a video to find out what work related expenses you can claim.

 Work related expenses - an overview 

 You will find out about what:

 • qualifies for tax relief and how it works

 • you cannot claim for

 • records and receipts you’ll need to make a claim

 • flat rate expenses are

 • you need to do to claim through Self Assessment or directly with HMRC

 Working from home expenses

 Watch a video to find out what work expenses you can claim for working from home.

 What expenses can I claim for working from home? 

 You will find out about:

 • who can claim working from home expenses

 • what costs are eligible and what are not

 • how much you can claim

 • what evidence you need to provide

 • claiming for earlier tax years

 How to add a tax through your business tax account

 Watch a video to find out how to add a tax through your business tax account.

 How to add a tax through your business tax account .

 You’ll find out how to add the following services:

 • Corporation Tax

 • Self Assessment

 • PAYE for employers

 • VAT

 How to store your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet

 Watch a video about how to safely store your National Insurance number.

 How to store your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet 

 You will find out how to add your National Insurance number to your Apple or Google wallet using:

 • the HMRC app

 • your HMRC online account

 The Informants Scheme — reporting tax fraud or avoidance

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about the Informants Scheme and how to report tax fraud or avoidance .

 The Informants Scheme is a campaign to encourage people to report tax fraud in exchange for a reward.

 You will learn about:

 • how the scheme works

 • who can make a report

 • the information you’ll need

 • what happens after you’ve made a report

 • confidentiality and how we handle information

 Research and Development ( R&D ) for tax purposes

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Research and Development for tax purposes .

 You’ll learn about:

 • 
 R&D for tax purposes

 • what does and does not qualify for tax relief

 Research and Development ( R&D ) — how to claim R&D tax relief

 Watch a video about how to claim R&D tax relief.

 How do I claim Research and Development ( R&D ) tax relief? 

 You’ll find out about:

 • what types of projects are eligible for R&D tax relief

 • what is not classed as an R&D project

 • how to claim R&D tax relief

 Recorded webinar

 Watch a recorded webinar about Research and Development — how to claim Research and Development tax relief .

 You’ll learn about what you need to do when making a claim for R&D tax relief.

 The merged scheme for Research and Development ( R&D ) expenditure credit

 Watch a recorded webinar about the merged scheme for Research and Development expenditure credit .

 You’ll learn about:

 • the merged scheme

 • contracted out R&D 

 • subsidised expenditure

 • additional tax relief for R&D intensive small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs)
